item.title: Timberwolves sign forward Kyle Anderson
item.description: (Timberwolves.com) The Minnesota Timberwolves today announced the team has signed forward Kyle Anderson. Per team policy, terms of the agreement were not released. Anderson, 6-8, has played in 24 games (three starts) this season with the Utah Jazz and the Memphis Grizzlies where he averaged 7.5 points on 56.3% shooting, 3.3 rebounds and 2.7 assists in 20.4 minutes per game.
